items.title: Nick Polites Interview, 1963-10-08
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] The band, didn't it? Yes, Flea's a Bird and all that.

ctx.x: No, he, unfortunately, he was a fine pianist, strong sort of honky-tonk sort of style. And, unfortunately, he died suddenly, something caught in his throat or something. Oh. Yes, it was very, he was playing with the Frank Johnson band. And, suddenly, we heard he died at a big funeral for him. We played at the funeral.
The band, didn't it? Yes, Flea's a Bird and all that. At the grave side? Yes, at the grave side.

We didn't want to, or we sort of didn't want to if it was going to affect his relatives at all. You know, they didn't know anything about jazz. But, his wife insisted. Mm-hmm. So, we did it. They were very happy about it. Happy. They were very glad we did it. Mm-hmm.
